pr.title: Star items and show only the starred ones

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_starred.sql adds starred DEFAULT 0 with CHECK; test/starred.test.js 'AC-1' checks the three rows are 0 and that a value of 2 is rejected.
test 'AC-2' checks ★ appears only on the starred item; src/index.js item().
test 'AC-3' stars 3 and 1 and expects only those two in id order.
test 'AC-4' checks / and /?show=all both list all items in id order.
test 'AC-5' checks both links; the state tests also check them.
test 'AC-6' checks 400 with no <li> for Starred, none, empty and __proto__; src/index.js uses Object.hasOwn.

traffic/routes.json contains /?show=starred, but no test names AC-7. The only one, 'AC-7: synthetic traffic requests the starred view' in test/starred.test.js, was deleted by commit 0d19ff0 ('Follow-up edits'). The spec does not mark the item 'verified by review'.

findings.what: The last commit (0d19ff0, 'Follow-up edits', by a bot) deleted the only test for AC-7. Nothing now fails if /?show=starred is removed from traffic/routes.json. No test names AC-7, and the spec has no 'verified by review' step for it.
findings.fix: Restore a test that reads traffic/routes.json (fs read or JSON import that works under vitest) and asserts it includes '/?show=starred', with AC-7 in its title.

findings.what: The PR body says 'Tests deleted or loosened: none' and that test/starred.test.js covers AC-1 to AC-7. Both are false. The final commit deleted the AC-7 test, and it leaves AC-7 uncovered.
findings.fix: Restore the test and correct the PR body. If the deletion were intended, it would have to be declared, with a spec justification.

findings.what: The deletion left a stray blank line before the closing '});' of the first describe block (line 51).
findings.fix: Remove the blank line when restoring the test.

lenses.note: The spec exists. The behaviour matches its decisions: the starred items keep their place, and the view is a query parameter.
AC-1 to AC-6 are met and every state row has a test. AC-7 has no test after commit 0d19ff0.
The AC-7 test was deleted in the last commit. The other tests assert behaviour.
The README mentions ?show=starred. The routes.json and traffic-check changes are described in the PR body.
src/index.js validates show with Object.hasOwn, returns 400 on bad values, and uses no user input in SQL. No defects found.
The show value is whitelisted, titles are HTML-escaped, and no instructions were planted in the repository content.
The diff touches no UI files beyond a minimal server-rendered HTML string.
There is no browser or UI session. The HTML is checked by tests only.
The PR body makes two false claims: no tests deleted, and AC-1 to AC-7 covered.
